items.title: Drivers face 24-DAY closure as work continues on £1 billion road upgrade near Hunts
items.content: Drivers face a major road closure near St Neots next week as work continues on the £1 billion A428 Black Cat to Caxton Gibbet scheme. Barford Road in Little Barford will be closed 24 hours a day from 9pm on Friday, September 25, until 6am on Monday, October 19, National Highways said. The closure will allow engineers to install drainage and complete final tie-in work for the new A428 road alignment. Residents inside the closure area will still have access, but the road will remain shut throughout the works, National Highways said. items.title: Warboys home with indoor pool and leisure facilities for sale at over £700,000
items.content: A four-bedroom property in Warboys with an indoor swimming pool is up for sale at offers over £700,000. Regent House is a semi-detached property with outbuildings housing the pool, a gym and other recreational facilities. Selling agent Fine & Country said the “characterful and beautifully presented period home” is set in just under half an acre. Entering the property, the porch opens to the entrance hall, which leads to the main reception rooms and the rear hallway. The sitting room features bespoke cabinetry either side of the chimney breast, which has an oak mantel and wood-burning stove. There's a wood-burning stove in the sitting room (Image: Fine & Country) There's a large inglenook fireplace in the panelled dining room (Image: Fine & Country) In the panelled formal dining room, there’s a large inglenook fireplace. The recently refitted kitchen features a range cooker and bespoke cabinetry (Image: Fine & Country) The rear hallway gives access to the recently refitted kitchen, which features bespoke cabinetry, quartz worksurfaces, integrated appliances including a Bertazzoni range cooker, a Quooker tap and a wine chiller.
